title: Deep Rock Galactic
provenance: Reported by theeirdna-commits (highball-db#819, #821 and #822, 2026-10-30), Apple M1, macOS 15.7.7, Highball 0.10.22, DXMT with a 60 fps cap: 5 of 5 after 2 minutes on engine x64-crossover26.3-r27 (Wine 11), 5 of 5 after 12 minutes and 4 of 5 after 25 minutes on x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, frame drops when swarms come even on the lowest settings. Earlier listed from community consensus (AppleGamingWiki, r/macgaming, MacPlay). Not verified by the maintainer. DrGablonski (highball-db#1350, 2026-11-20), Apple M4, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 31 minutes: with async shader compilation on, AVX advertised (also set as ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1) and the steam and vcrun2022 recipes. paddy919 (highball-db#1395, 2026-11-22), Apple M4, macOS 27.2.1, not through the Highball app but through Proton-ish 1.0.66 (HighballKit 0.10.26) from the macOS Steam client, the Wine 11 engine x64-crossover26.3-r29, DXMT, sync off, AVX advertised, rated 5 of 5 after about an hour: one solo match and one full squad game of four players at 1440p on medium settings, around 60 fps, with FSR 2.0 in the game for more. Full squad games with many enemies drop from about 80 to about 40 fps in some scenes.
notes: Plays on DXMT on an M1 on both engine lines, with frame drops in big swarms even on the lowest settings. Easy Anti-Cheat runs in user space here and does not stop it. A base M4 rated it perfect over 31 minutes with DXMT on the default engine r28 (highball-db#1350).
